title: Summarise a CSV from the command line
hints: Handle the arguments first, then the file, then the data, returning early with an error object at each step that can fail. That keeps the happy path at the end, unindented.

`Number("oops")` is `NaN`, but `Number("")` is `0`, so treat an empty cell as not a number explicitly. Sort with `b[1] - a[1] || a[0].localeCompare(b[0])`: by total, then by name when the totals are equal.
